object.description: Through the MCP server, export a document to output paths that name a Windows device (NUL.pdf, nul.PDF, CON .pdf, aux.notes.pdf, out/COM1.pdf, lpt9.pdf), hold a colon after the drive (notes.txt:x.pdf, out/a:b.pdf) or name a device or pipe path (a pipe in the device namespace, with either slash, and a drive in the device namespace); then to an ordinary relative path in the same session. Where pipes and device files can be made that way, also export to an existing named pipe and to a link to the null device. Expected: each unsafe path is refused with a validation error, no hidden stream is written into notes.txt and no out folder is made; the ordinary path gets a PDF.
